smoke_tests.description: Full happy-path smoke test: nightshift run --audit processes one issue, creates both JSONL files, and emits session.init, spec.inmemory_created, and spec.afspec_created events with correct payloads.
smoke_tests.trigger: Invoke 'nightshift run --audit' with a single mock GitHub issue (issue_number=42) available in the knowledge base.
mockable: DuckDB database (use in-memory or temp file)
expected_effects: File .agent-fox/audit/agent_{run_id}.jsonl exists and contains at least one line with event_type == 'session.init' with non-empty system_prompt and task_prompt
File .agent-fox/audit/audit_{run_id}.jsonl exists and contains at least one line with event_type == 'spec.inmemory_created' where payload.issue_number == 42
File .agent-fox/audit/audit_{run_id}.jsonl contains at least one line with event_type == 'spec.afspec_created' where payload.requirements_count >= 1 and payload.rendered is non-empty
All events in both JSONL files share the same run_id value equal to ctx.obj['audit_run_id']

smoke_tests.description: No-audit smoke test: nightshift run without --audit processes one issue, creates no JSONL files, and the dispatcher contains only DuckDBSink.
smoke_tests.trigger: Invoke 'nightshift run' (without --audit) with a single mock GitHub issue available in the knowledge base.
mockable: DuckDB database (use in-memory or temp file)
expected_effects: No files matching agent_*.jsonl exist in .agent-fox/audit/ after the run
No files matching audit_*.jsonl exist in .agent-fox/audit/ after the run
AgentTraceSink and AuditJsonlSink are never instantiated

smoke_tests.description: Unwritable audit directory smoke test: nightshift run --audit on a system where .agent-fox/audit/ is not writable logs a WARNING and starts the daemon normally with only DuckDBSink.
smoke_tests.trigger: Invoke 'nightshift run --audit' with .agent-fox/audit/ set to permissions 000 (not writable) before the run.
mockable: DuckDB database (use in-memory or temp file)
expected_effects: A WARNING-level log message is emitted describing the unwritable audit directory
AgentTraceSink and AuditJsonlSink are NOT attached to the dispatcher
No agent_*.jsonl or audit_*.jsonl files are created
Daemon starts and completes the run normally
